div.p: Please read carefully before proceeding

As part of our regulatory obligations under UAE AML/CFT requirements applicable to DNFBPs, we are required="required" to obtain and verify customer due diligence (KYC) information before commencement of the engagement. This process helps us verify the legal existence of the entity/individual, identify shareholders, directors, managers, and UBOs, understand the nature of business activities, and comply with sanctions screening and AML regulations.
Please fill in all relevant sections of the KYC form carefully.
Please provide clear and valid supporting documents along with the completed form.
Please ensure all information provided is complete, accurate, and consistent with supporting documents. Any mismatch may result in additional queries and delays.
Fields marked with * are mandatory. Where a field is not applicable, please mention "N/A".

Verify that all sections are completed, all required="required" documents are attached, ownership percentages total 100%, names match legal documents, and the authorised signatory has reviewed the form.
The KYC form must be signed by an authorised signatory / director / shareholder / manager, as applicable.
Our AML/KYC team may request further information after initial review depending on the risk assessment and regulatory requirements.
